Class ProductDTO

java.lang.Object
com.konbini.dto.ProductDTO
public class ProductDTO extends Object
Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing product information. Used to transfer product data between layers without exposing the domain model. Contains product details, inventory information, and expiration status.
